input.rationale: Section 9 is limited to mutual corporate representations (organization, authority, enforceability, no conflicts) plus an HDI acknowledgement about the Globix Agreement. Nowhere in the Agreement does HDI warrant the quality of the Services it performs (design, development, implementation, hosting, maintenance and management of the Site), give any conformance warranty for the Site or other deliverables, warrant compliance with laws or the absence of malicious code, and there is no warranty remedy. That fails even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with repair, replace or refund) because there is no express performance warranty at all. Per the detection guidance, a missing express warranty is a deviation to be cured by insertion; we have inserted the preferred performance warranty as a new Section 9(c) with a 90-day conformance period and a re-performance/repair/replacement/refund remedy. Mitigating context noted but not sufficient: Section 5.2 gives the Company acceptance control and Section 1.6 allows termination if the Site is not operational in 70 days, and there is no "AS IS" disclaimer (so this is not walk-away territory).

proposal.summary: Add an express HDI performance warranty (workmanlike services, 90-day conformance for the Site/deliverables, compliance with laws, no malicious code) with a repair/re-perform/refund remedy in Section 9.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only mutual authority representations, so HDI gives no warranty at all on the development, hosting and maintenance work it performs. We have added our standard performance warranty with a 90-day conformance period and a re-performance, repair, replacement or refund remedy; we can discuss a shorter period or narrower remedy if that is easier for HDI.

ops.text: (c) HDI represents and warrants to the Company that: (1) the Services, including the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance and management of the Site, will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards by personnel with the requisite skill and experience; (2) for a period of ninety (90) days following the Company's written acceptance of the Site or any other deliverable pursuant to Section 5.2, the Site and each such deliverable will conform in all material respects to the requirements and documentation agreed by the Parties; (3) it shall perform its obligations under this Agreement in compliance with all applicable laws, rules and regulations; and (4) the Site and any software or code delivered or used by HDI in connection with the Site will be free of any virus, worm, back door, disabling device or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of the warranty in clause (2) is, at HDI's option, re-performance, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Site or deliverable or, if HDI fails to cure within thirty (30) days of notice, a refund of the fees paid by the Company for the non-conforming Services or deliverable.
